title: TimesheetApprovalStatusCompact
description: A *timesheet approval status* object represents the approval status for a user's timesheet for a given week. It tracks whether the timesheet is in draft, submitted, approved, or rejected status.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

created_at.description: The time at which this resource was created.

user.description: The user whose timesheet this approval status is for.

workspace.description: The workspace in which the timesheet approval status exists.

start_date.description: The start date of the timesheet week.

end_date.description: The end date of the timesheet week.

approval_status.description: The current approval status of the timesheet.
